component.name: PHP IDE
component.summary: Write, run, debug and test PHP projects

description.p: PHP IDE is a free and open source development environment for PHP, written in Rust. It follows PhpStorm's keyboard shortcuts and navigation.

ul.li: Code editor with multiple carets, folding, split views and smooth scrolling on large files
Completion, documentation, rename and quick fixes through intelephense or phpactor
Run configurations, Xdebug debugger and PHPUnit with coverage
Git: commit with hunk staging, side-by-side diff, branches, push and pull, log
Integrated terminal, Search Everywhere, Find and Replace in Files, Recent Locations
Recovery of unsaved changes after a crash
